from PyQt5.QtWidgets import *
from PyQt5.uic import loadUi
def calcul():
    try:
        n=int(w.txtN.text())
        u0=1
        u1=1
        w.table.setRowCount(0)  # vider le QTableWidget
        w.table.insertRow(0)
        w.table.setItem(0,0,QTableWidgetItem("U0="))
        w.table.setItem(0,1,QTableWidgetItem(str(u0)))
        w.table.insertRow(1)
        w.table.setItem(1,0,QTableWidgetItem("U1="))
        w.table.setItem(1,1,QTableWidgetItem(str(u1)))
        for i in range (2,n+1):
            u=u0+u1
            u0=u1
            u1=u
            w.table.insertRow(i)
            w.table.setItem(i,0,QTableWidgetItem("U"+str(i)+"="))
            w.table.setItem(i,1,QTableWidgetItem(str(u)))
    except:
        QMessageBox.critical(w,'attention'," c'est pas un nombre!!")

###############  PP  ###########
app=QApplication([])
w=loadUi("interface.ui")
w.btnCalculer.clicked.connect(calcul)

w.show()
app.exec_()
